description.narrative: Gender & Diversity is one of the three cross-cutting themes of the West & Central Africa regional strategy. As part of our partnership agreement with the Guinean RC with which we work through the consortium we have agreed to support the NS development and mainstreaming of G&D across programmes. BRC also has the intention to contribute to furthering the G&D agenda in the WCA region and support the Federation in doing this. The focus of our work has been on francophone African NS which don t even have access to most of the Movement s resources (only available in English). In November 2016 BRC organised in collaboration with other PNS and the Federation a training on Gender & Diversity for french-speaking NS based on the 7 moves training. following this training the PNS have agreed to keep the working group alive and continue working to improve the training material and support their bilateral partners in their gender maintreaming efforts. BRC WCA team has put together a Plan of Action for the team and a corresponding budget for 2017. The HP team is also supporting the advocacy effort with the drafting of briefings based on the ongoing projects taking place in the region that have a strong gender component. Research plans might also be formulated later in 2017.
